blocks.prompt: 2. Find the moment of inertia of a uniform triangular lamina about its base.
blocks.explanation:
A moment of inertia of a continuous body: strip method with strips parallel to the axis (the base).
Given: a uniform triangle; call its base \(a\), its height \(h\) and its mass \(M\).
Plan: strip at height \(y\), its length from similar triangles, \(\delta m\) from the density, then \(I = \int_0^h y^{2}\,dm\).
steps:
Given: uniform triangular lamina \(ABC\), base \(BC = a\), height \(h\) (from \(A\) to \(BC\)), mass \(M\).
To find: \(I\) about the base \(BC\).
Method: cut the triangle into thin strips parallel to \(BC\). Every point of a strip is at the same distance \(y\) from \(BC\), so its moment of inertia is \(y^{2}\,\delta m\).

Density
\[\text{Area} = \dfrac{1}{2}ah, \qquad \rho = \dfrac{M}{\frac{1}{2}ah} = \dfrac{2M}{ah}\]
Why: the lamina is uniform, so mass per unit area = total mass \(\div\) area.

Length of the strip at height \(y\)
The strip \(PQ\) at distance \(y\) from \(BC\) cuts off a small triangle \(APQ\) of height \(h - y\), similar to \(ABC\).
\[\dfrac{PQ}{BC} = \dfrac{h - y}{h} \Rightarrow PQ = \dfrac{a(h - y)}{h}\]
Why: in similar triangles, corresponding lengths are in the ratio of the heights.

Mass of the strip (thickness \(\delta y\))
\[\delta m = \dfrac{2M}{ah}\cdot\dfrac{a(h - y)}{h}\,\delta y\]
\[= \dfrac{2M}{h^{2}}(h - y)\,\delta y\]
Why: mass = density \(\times\) area, and the strip's area is \(PQ \times \delta y\).

Add all the strips
\[I = \int_{0}^{h} y^{2}\cdot\dfrac{2M}{h^{2}}(h - y)\,dy\]
\[= \dfrac{2M}{h^{2}}\int_{0}^{h}(hy^{2} - y^{3})\,dy\]
Why: the strips run from the base (\(y = 0\)) to the vertex \(A\) (\(y = h\)).

Check
Units: mass \(\times\) length\(^2\) \(\checkmark\). The base length \(a\) cancelled, which makes sense: widening the triangle along the base does not move mass farther from the base. Radius of gyration \(R = \frac{h}{\sqrt{6}}\).
blocks.final_answer: \(I = \dfrac{1}{6}Mh^{2}\), where \(M\) is the mass and \(h\) the height of the triangle measured from the base.
